decision.explanation: Two distinct referents named 'Scott Fitzgerald' appear in the sources. One is a footballer mentioned in D2S3, who was born in 1975. The other is a singer mentioned in D5S4, born on 28 April 1948. Both claims are directly sourced and refer to different individuals with the same name. The year-only form '1948' is not independently supported and is omitted in favor of the more specific and directly quoted form '28 April 1948'.
